modbus_hub_conflict.message: Home Assistant Modbus may be using this gateway. Resolve the native device repair before writing.

entity_write_mode.message: ha-spark owns this control in {mode}. Start manual control before editing it. Discharge controls require a manual session.

protection_owned.message: Protection owns the power switch. Start manual control without kept protection to edit it.

read_only.message: This device is read-only. Resolve its native device repair before writing.

limits.message: The request cannot be made within the confirmed device, bank and site limits.

untrusted_soc.message: Battery SoC is not trusted. Check the bank SoC trust entity before increasing charging or editing a charge window.

grid_charge_not_permitted.message: The inverter does not permit grid charging. ha-spark never changes that permission.

invalid_intent.message: The requested value or window is invalid. Use whole minutes and different start and end times, or midnight at both ends to disable a half.

entity_write_failed.message: The device write failed. Check connectivity before trying again.

entity_write_unverified.message: The device write could not be verified by read-back. Check connectivity and the native device repair.

not_available.message: This command is not available yet.

stale_session.message: The command belongs to an earlier add-on session.

stale_authority.message: Authority changed before this command could run.

replayed.message: This command sequence was already consumed.

stale_epoch.message: Authority changed. Refresh its epoch before making a new request.

preconditions_unmet.message: The native mode preconditions have not all been met.

native_device_missing.message: No configured native inverter matches this request.

not_owner.message: Only a non-system administrator on an integration-owned site may do this.

authority_unknown.message: Authority is unknown. Confirm Observe through the repair before writing.

transition_in_progress.message: An authority transition is still in progress.

no_manual_session.message: There is no manual session to resume.

not_in_active_mode.message: Manual control requires Protect or Optimise and no existing manual session.

invalid_household_zone.message: Configure a valid household time zone before choosing until tomorrow.

not_admin.message: Only a non-system Home Assistant administrator may do that.

commands_pending.name: Commands pending
commands_pending.description: Prompt a fetch from the authenticated add-on channel. Accepts no command data.

reprobe.name: Re-probe Solis
reprobe.description: Re-read identity and test gateway caching (administrator only).

set_observe.name: Set Observe
set_observe.description: Make a verified handover to Observe.

start_manual_control.name: Start manual control
start_manual_control.description: Temporarily hand over controls to the owner.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: One hour, next household-clock morning, or until resumed.

keep_protection.name: Keep protection
keep_protection.description: Keep battery-to-car protection during manual control.

resume_control.name: Resume control
resume_control.description: End manual control using current conditions.

evidence_options_invalid.title: Protection evidence options need saving again
evidence_options_invalid.description: The stored native protection evidence settings are invalid, for example an entity source without a maximum age. Open the integration options, choose Native protection evidence, check every source and its maximum age, then continue to Site topology and Save. Until then no new protection hold starts, and an existing hold is kept until its last trusted dispatch end or an explicit handover.

export_reading_missing.title: Site grid reading missing during an export
export_reading_missing.description: The whole-site grid power reading has been missing or stale for over two minutes while a supervised export is live. The export continues within the inverter's confirmed bound; the tripwire cannot watch the site export limit until the reading returns.

clock_drift.title: Inverter clock differs from the household clock

confirm.title: Synchronise inverter clock
confirm.description: The native inverter clock differs by more than five minutes. Resident windows follow this clock. An administrator can synchronise it with the household clock. Write the household clock to this inverter and verify it by read-back. This is an explicit clock write, including in Observe or manual control.

error.authority_unknown: Recover authority through the Observe repair before writing.
error.stale_authority: Authority changed. Try again under the current authority.
error.transition_in_progress: Wait for the authority transition to finish.
error.not_available: The integration is stopping or unavailable.
error.invalid_household_zone: Configure a valid household time zone first.
error.read_only: The inverter is read-only. Resolve its native device repair first.
error.modbus_hub_conflict: Home Assistant Modbus may be using this gateway. Resolve the native device repair first.
error.unverified: The clock write could not be verified. Check connectivity and try again.
error.failed: The clock write failed. Check connectivity and try again.

abort.entry_unavailable: The config entry is not loaded.
abort.native_device_missing: The native inverter is no longer configured.

native_held_identity_remapped.title: Held control mapping changed
native_held_identity_remapped.description: The original hold is retained. Move to Observe before using a replacement mapping. Native writes remain blocked.

native_unreachable.title: Solis gateway unreachable
native_unreachable.description: Check gateway connectivity, then Re-probe. The device remains read-only.

native_identity_read_failed.title: Solis identity probe failed
native_identity_read_failed.description: Identity or caching could not be verified. Check connectivity and Re-probe. The device remains read-only.

native_unvalidated_identity.title: Solis identity not validated
native_unvalidated_identity.description: This identity is not in the validated allow-list. The device remains read-only.

native_v2_tou_firmware.title: Unsupported Solis TOU firmware
native_v2_tou_firmware.description: V2 TOU firmware is read-only. Do not enable automatic control.

native_caching_on.title: Gateway caching detected
native_caching_on.description: Disable gateway storage mode, then Re-probe. Read-back is not trustworthy while caching is on.

native_modbus_hub_conflict.title: Home Assistant Modbus uses the Solis gateway
native_modbus_hub_conflict.description: Home Assistant's Modbus integration has a hub or connection on this gateway. Remove or disable it. Reads continue; native writes stay blocked until it is gone.

native_modbus_hub_unreadable.title: Home Assistant Modbus connections unreadable
native_modbus_hub_unreadable.description: Home Assistant's Modbus integration is loaded but its connections could not be read. Native writes stay blocked; reads continue. Check the Modbus integration after a Home Assistant update.

native_gateway_not_owned.title: Solis gateway not owned
native_gateway_not_owned.description: Confirm the gateway claim in native setup, complete the authority handshake and remove the legacy overlay. Reads continue; writes remain blocked.

ownership_peer_version.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_peer_version.description: Switching authority requires a v4 add-on with known authority. Restore a compatible peer and retry, or revert the topology.

ownership_store_unknown.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_store_unknown.description: The authority or ownership store must be known before switching. Recover the store and retry, or revert the topology.

ownership_observe_required.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_observe_required.description: Both authorities must be in Observe before switching. Set Observe and retry, or revert the topology.

ownership_holds_present.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_holds_present.description: Clear every hold before switching authority. Holds are never migrated. Retry when clear, or revert the topology.

ownership_transition_present.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_transition_present.description: Finish the authority transition before switching. Retry when complete, or revert the topology.

ownership_manual_present.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_manual_present.description: End manual control before switching authority. Retry when complete, or revert the topology.

ownership_switch_pending.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_switch_pending.description: An authority switch is already pending. Wait for the v4 handshake before retrying.

ownership_save_failed.title: Authority switch refused
ownership_save_failed.description: Ownership could not be saved and verified. All native writes remain blocked. Recover the store before retrying.

confirm.title: Confirm Observe
confirm.description: The integration cannot verify its authority store. No native writes are permitted. Confirm Observe to recover, then re-escalate through readiness. Reset the integration authority to Observe with a new identity. This writes no hardware and does not change the add-on's authority.

error.save_failed: The authority save could not be verified. No writes are permitted. Try again.

abort.entry_unavailable: The config entry is not loaded.
abort.authority_known: Authority is already known. This repair cannot change its mode.

api_version_skew.title: ha-spark API versions are incompatible
api_version_skew.description: The ha-spark add-on release {addon_release} speaks API version {addon_api_version} (supported: {addon_supported}). The integration sent API version {integration_api_version} and supports: {supported}. Update the add-on or integration so they support a common API version, then restart the updated half.

error.invalid_manual_time: Enter a valid HH:MM deadline and household time zone.
error.invalid_evidence: Configure EV status, battery direction and a positive finite maximum age for every configured source.
error.invalid_soc_policy: Enter a positive finite report age and whole-number failure and recovery settings of at least one.
error.out_of_range: Enter a number in the valid range for this field.
error.invalid_id: Use 1-64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens.
error.duplicate_id: This identifier is already in use.
error.unknown_bank: Choose one of the configured battery banks.
error.unknown_connection: Choose one of the configured grid connections.
error.duplicate_v2l_bank: This bank already has a V2L charger.
error.invalid_soc_range: The minimum SoC must not exceed the target cap.
error.invalid_load_attribution: Enter either a served-load share or a load source, not both and not neither.
error.invalid_load_demand: Enter the demand fields for this kind of load.
error.multiple_dispatch_loads: Only one EV charger can be marked as the one dispatches drive.
error.invalid_load_shares: The served-load shares of banks without a load source on one connection must sum to 100%.
error.incomplete_topology: The site needs at least one connection, bank and inverter.
error.invalid_topology: The topology is not valid. Check the entries and try again.
error.invalid_native_gateway: Native transport requires a Solis inverter and a gateway host.
error.ownership_peer_version: Switching authority requires a connected v4 add-on with known authority.
error.ownership_store_unknown: The authority or ownership store must be known before switching.
error.ownership_observe_required: Set the current authority to Observe before switching.
error.ownership_holds_present: Clear every hold before switching authority. Holds are never migrated.
error.ownership_transition_present: Finish the authority transition before switching.
error.ownership_manual_present: End manual control before switching authority.
error.ownership_switch_pending: An authority switch is already pending. Wait for the v4 handshake.
error.ownership_save_failed: Ownership could not be saved and verified. All native writes remain blocked.
error.remove_last: The site needs at least one of these; it cannot be removed.
error.connection_in_use: Banks or major loads still use this connection.
error.bank_in_use: Inverters or a V2L charger still use this bank.
error.invalid_fallback: Enter a cheap-window start and end on the household clock and a current for every native inverter within its limits.
error.fallback_in_use: Fallback cannot be cleared while Optimise is committed or fallback is active.
error.fallback_invalidated: This edit would invalidate the saved fallback schedule. Update or clear the fallback first.

evidence.title: Native protection evidence
evidence.description: Only fresh reports may start or clear protection. Native battery direction uses successful bus reads. Protection requires Home Assistant to remain running; no switch persistence through a whole-HA outage is assumed. Kraken-only dispatches are not available natively. Continue to Site topology and Save to apply.

data.battery_direction_entity: Battery direction power entity (entity source only)

fallback.title: Native fallback schedule
fallback.description: The fallback charges only in this cheap window, at these per-inverter currents, when a cause is active in Optimise. Leave every field empty to clear it only outside Optimise.

soc.title: Native SoC trust policy
soc.description: Recovery requires continuous passing native observations. Saving restarts recovery progress.

manual.title: Manual control deadline
manual.description: Until tomorrow resolves to the next occurrence of this household-clock time. Existing deadlines do not change.

solcast.title: Solcast daily allowance
solcast.description: Choose 50 only for a legacy account with that allowance. Calls reset at midnight UTC.

topology.title: Site topology and limits
topology.description: Describe the site's grid connections, battery banks, inverters, V2L charger and major loads. Save applies the whole document at once.

connections_item.title: Grid connection
connections_item.description: One grid connection with its AC supply limits.

banks_item.title: Battery bank
banks_item.description: One energy store with its DC limits. Enter either a served-load share or a load source.

native_connect.title: Connect native Solis
native_connect.description: Confirm that all other Modbus clients and the legacy overlay are disconnected. Continuing probes identity and gateway caching and records your gateway ownership claim when you save. An unreachable device can be saved read-only; setup probes again after saving.

inverters_item.title: Inverter
inverters_item.description: One inverter with its owner-entered DC limits. Unconfirmed limits count as zero. Native Solis inverters go through a connect step and remain read-only until validated.

v2l_chargers_item.title: V2L charger
v2l_chargers_item.description: One V2L charger as a DC source into a bank; at most one per bank.

major_load_ev.title: EV charger
major_load_ev.description: One EV charger with its demand. At most one can be marked as the one dispatches drive.

major_load_heat.title: Heat pump
major_load_heat.description: One heat pump with both seasonal demands; it counts at the larger.

save.title: Save topology
save.description: Apply the whole topology document, or return to fix what is refused.

error.no_sites: This Solcast account has no rooftop sites.
error.too_many_sites: This Solcast account has more than two rooftop sites.
error.malformed: Solcast returned an invalid site list.
error.quota_exhausted: The daily Solcast call allowance is exhausted. Try after midnight UTC.
error.busy: Solcast is busy. Try again later.
error.server_error: Solcast is unavailable. Try again later.
error.unreachable: Cannot reach Solcast. Try again later.
error.stale: The Solcast quota store could not be read or saved. Requests are stopped.

reconfigure.title: Configure Solcast
reconfigure.description: Enter your Solcast API key. Leave it empty to remove native Solcast after confirmation. Turn off other Solcast pollers before saving.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Solcast
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a replacement Solcast API key.

clear_solcast.title: Remove native Solcast?
clear_solcast.description: Remove the saved key and sites? The add-on will use its legacy forecast entity settings.

confirm.title: ha-spark discovered
confirm.description: Connect the ha-spark add-on to this Home Assistant site?

abort.already_configured: This ha-spark site is already configured.
abort.invalid_discovery: The discovery is not from the ha-spark add-on or contains invalid connection data.
abort.addon_required: ha-spark is set up through its add-on. Install and start the ha-spark add-on: Home Assistant then discovers it and offers it here.
